semiconductor_relevance: High — Tokyo Keiso Co., Ltd. provides essential flow control components and measurement instruments used across various stages of semiconductor manufacturing.

Their products are used in clean room environments, process chemicals, and gas handling equipment, supporting critical functions such as analysis, measurement, and wafer handling.
